remarks:
Welcome to your private countryside retreat—where comfort, functionality, and stunning scenery come together beautifully. This thoughtfully designed home showcases contemporary design with warm, welcoming spaces throughout.
A winding driveway leads you to the home, perfectly positioned to capture elevated valley views. Relax and take in the scenery from the large covered front porch, an inviting space for morning coffee or peaceful evenings.
Enter into the 2 story foyer. The living room is filled with natural light and features a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect gathering space for relaxing or entertaining. The home also offers a large formal dining room, ideal for hosting holiday meals and special occasions.
The heart of the home is the chef’s kitchen, complete with a spacious island and plenty of room for cooking and gathering. The main floor also includes a convenient half bath and access to the attached 2-car garage with additional storage.
Upstairs, the primary suite with en suite bath offers a comfortable retreat with walk-in closets and private space to unwind. The second level also includes an additional full bath and the convenience of upstairs laundry.
The fully finished walk-out basement provides flexible living space—perfect for recreation, guests, or a home office.
Outside, enjoy everything this property has to offer. Cool off in the inground heated pool, garden in the fully fenced vegetable and flower garden, or make use of the many outbuildings, including a charming chicken coop.
With durable vinyl siding, beautiful views, and a rare combination of indoor comfort and outdoor amenities, this property offers space, privacy, and endless possibilities.
